correctness.rationale: Irreducible representation of Q_{4n} decomposes C[G] into four 1-dimensional blocks and n−1 dimension-two blocks with multiplicity two; explicit cos² determinant, nested dyadic congruences, valuation-forced zero block cases, odd-indexed exceptional zero blocks and scalar contributions yield the exact kernel formula. Inclusion-exclusion for r,u yields exact first moment. Replayed direct regular convolution matrix checker (mod 1000003) verified all 822 normalized samples for k=2,3 plus 195 deterministic cases for k=4,5 and moment counts for k=2..5. Finite modular checks are corroboration, not proof of all k.

value.rationale: The kernel dimension of a four-tap convolution is a natural spectral/invertibility invariant. Across a canonical infinite family of nonabelian finite groups, the theorem classifies all balanced supports, gives a sharply characterized n² extremal coset family and a surprising logarithmic mean alongside an asymptotically half-populated minimum-nullity class. Neither an arbitrary slice nor a known table recomputation; it supplies intrinsic structural and exact statistical information.
